title: How to create physical gift cards
summary: Turn your Hotplate e-gift cards into printed cards customers can give in person!
body_markdown:
[Hotplate gift cards](https://help.hotplate.com/en/articles/13720207-how-to-sell-gift-cards) are digital. You can create one from the Gift cards tab, or customers can buy one from your Storefront or through a drop. Around the holidays, many customers want something physical to hand over with their gift. Here’s how to make printed cards.


## Step 1: Design your card


1.


Open this Canva template:[https://canva.link/u28jdvyjsm1fyxr](https://canva.link/u28jdvyjsm1fyxr)


2.


Add your logo to **page 1** .


3.


Add your Storefront URL to **page 2** .


## Step 2: Print your cards


Choose one of these options:


#### Print with **Canva**


-


In your Canva design, click **Print with Canva** in the top right and follow the checkout steps.


#### Print with **MOO**


*If you like these examples, here's exactly how we made them!*


1.


Download **page 1** of your Canva design as a PNG.


2.


If this is your first MOO order, use this link for $25 off:[https://refer.moo.com/s/vxrcjc](https://refer.moo.com/s/vxrcjc) . Then click Business Cards → Cotton Business Cards (these work best for writing on) and start a new design.


3.


Upload your PNG as the **back** of the card.


4.
